gloss: from place to place; wandering; changing repeatedly

definitions.gloss: from place to place; wandering about
definitions.explanation: Moving repeatedly from one location to another.
Passing from one owner or possessor to another multiple times.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}を{求|もと}めて{転々|てんてん}とした。
examples.english: I wandered from place to place looking for work.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{転々|てんてん}と{住所|じゅうしょ}を{変|か}えている。
examples.english: He keeps changing his address repeatedly.

examples.japanese: この{絵|え}は{転々|てんてん}と{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}を{変|か}えてきた。
examples.english: This painting has changed hands many times.

notes:
{転々|てんてん} is a reduplication of {転|てん} (to roll; to turn; to change), describing repeated movement or transfer.

USAGE:
- {転々|てんてん}とする (to wander from place to place)
- {転々|てんてん}と{変|か}える (to change repeatedly)
- {転々|てんてん}と{暮|く}らす (to live moving from place to place)

NUANCE:
This word often implies instability or restlessness - someone who can't settle down or something that keeps getting passed around.

HOMOPHONE:
{点々|てんてん} - has the same reading but different meaning (here and there; dotted about). Different kanji.

CONTRAST:
- {転々|てんてん} (rolling/moving repeatedly)
- {点々|てんてん} (scattered dots)
